incidents.name: Beanstalk flash-loaned governance BIP-18/BIP-19
incidents.notes: The attacker flash-loaned ~$1B of stablecoins, deposited them into the Silo to acquire a supermajority of Stalk in the same block, and used emergencyCommit() on a self-submitted BIP whose diamondCut init drained the protocol - legitimately acquired governance power, not a code defect.

sources.ref: onchain review: Beanstalk diamond 0xC1E088fC1323b20BCBee9bd1B9fC9546db5624C5 created 2021-08-06T22:27:12Z by 0x925753106fcdb6d2f30c3db295328a0a1c5fd1d1, unrelated to the attack sender 0x1c5dcdd0...; the diamond emits DiamondCut, not EIP-1967 Upgraded, so measure.mjs sees zero upgrade events and would wrongly report a 252-day deployment age. Scanning DiamondCut logs on the diamond over blocks 14500000-14595906 gives cuts at 14541362, 14541420 and 14547427; the last (2022-04-08T21:06:19Z, ts 1649451979) is the pre-incident code state, so codeAge = 1650106485 - 1649451979 = 654,506 s (7.6 days). Loss ~$181M drained from the Silo (attacker net ~$76M after repaying the flash loan).

incidents.documentedLastChange: 2022-04-08T21:06:19Z (block 14547427, tx 0x47f8937e3d03a68e512d67665cdc61cbcfbb122d71a3b5c2817186ddf476e8ef): last DiamondCut on the Beanstalk diamond before the incident
